seo.title: Bar 7 – Live Sport & Drinks in Upton upon Severn
seo.description: Visit Bar 7 on Old Street, Upton upon Severn, for drinks, live sport, music, pool and darts near Great Malvern in Worcestershire.

hero.title: Your local sports bar on Old Street
hero.lead: A friendly Upton upon Severn pub for matchday drinks and relaxed nights out in the Malvern Hills area, within easy reach of Great Malvern.

image.alt: Busy pub bar with drinks and warm lighting

highlights.title: Live sport
highlights.text: Big games, local favourites, and a proper matchday atmosphere.

image.alt: Live football shown on the screens at Bar 7

highlights.title: Cold pints
highlights.text: Lager, ale, cider, and bottled favourites served straight from the bar.

image.alt: Drinks lined up and ready to serve at Bar 7

highlights.title: In-house pizzeria
highlights.text: Order at the bar and have food delivered from Mojitos just down the road. Pay by cash or card with no added delivery fee.

liveMusic.alt: Guests watching live music at Bar 7
liveMusic.caption: Packed-out room

intro.heading: Built for easy nights out
intro.text: Bar 7 keeps things simple: good service, a warm room, live sport on screen, and enough choice to satisfy the whole table.

features.title: Matchday ready
features.text: Screens positioned for easy viewing, with a soundtrack that lifts when the crowd does.

features.title: Friendly for groups
features.text: Plenty of room for after-work drinks, birthdays, and low-key celebrations.

features.title: Easy to find
features.text: You'll find us on Old Street in Upton upon Severn, a short walk from the town centre.
